run_unmt_translation: run unsupervised NMT translation to generate questions from cloze-style text inputs
preprocess_cloze_data: preprocess cloze data by tokenizing, applying BPE, and binarizing for NMT inference
get_unmt_questions_for_clozes: get generated questions for a list of cloze entries using unsupervised NMT with configurable model paths
build_unmt_params: build UnsupervisedNMT inference parameters from experiment configuration and model checkpoint paths
convert_batch_to_text: convert a batch of encoded sentences to readable text using the model dictionary and language ID
